entries.role: Operations Research (NUS System Design Project), Contract

text.default: Design an AI-driven put-away recommendation system for STMicroelectronics' Singapore warehouse, replacing experience-based slotting with capacity-aware decisions drawn from 3 live inputs: picking history, demand forecasts, and available capacity.
text.deep: Design an AI-driven put-away recommendation system for STMicroelectronics' Singapore semiconductor warehouse, replacing experience-based slotting with systematic, capacity-aware storage recommendations drawn from 3 live inputs: picking history, demand forecasts, and available capacity.

inputs-first.text: Design an AI-driven put-away recommendation system for STMicroelectronics' Singapore warehouse from 3 live inputs: picking history, demand forecasts, and available capacity, in place of experience-based slotting.
inputs-first.note: leads on the inputs and closes on a noun phrase rather than a trailing participle

text.default: Build vision systems for 3 imaging workstreams: camera ISP enhancement, super-resolution, and image restoration under motion and low light.
Train UNet and other CNN architectures for single-image super-resolution, upscaling frames 4 times and lifting PSNR and SSIM so a low-cost camera reaches frame quality on par with premium sensors.
text.deep: Train UNet and other CNN architectures for single-image super-resolution, upscaling frames 4 times and measuring the gain on PSNR and SSIM so a low-cost camera reaches frame quality on par with premium sensors before those frames reach downstream robotics perception.

text.default: Deliver AI-enabled systems and data workflows for process improvement, manufacturing analytics, operational decision support, and supply-chain automation.
Strengthen monitoring and process structure across healthcare supply chains with AI, protecting product availability for vulnerable patient groups.

Assemble a 5-stage offline process-intelligence platform for globally distributed spray-drying plants: GPU OCR and layout parsing, recursive chunking, ONNX embeddings, a Chroma vector store, and LangChain over a locally hosted Gemma model.
text.deep: Assemble a 5-stage offline process-intelligence platform for globally distributed spray-drying plants: GPU OCR and layout parsing (marker, PyTorch/CUDA), recursive chunking (chonkie), bge-small ONNX embeddings (fastembed), a Chroma vector store with top-k similarity ranking, and LangChain over a locally hosted Gemma 4 E4B served through llama.cpp GGUF.

build-first.text: Build a 5-stage offline process-intelligence platform for globally distributed spray-drying plants: GPU OCR and layout parsing, recursive chunking, ONNX embeddings, a Chroma vector store, and LangChain over a locally hosted Gemma model.
build-first.note: leads on building the platform rather than on assembling the stack

text.default: Convert 4 plants' Advanced Process Control models from Excel master files into a single HiGHS linear program returning setpoints, binding constraints, and shadow prices at millisecond latency.
text.deep: Convert 4 site-specific vendor formulations' Advanced Process Control steady-state models from their Excel master files into a single HiGHS linear program (scipy.optimize.linprog) with a tracking QP and PLC predictor covering every site, returning setpoints, binding constraints, shadow prices, and trust-region warnings at millisecond latency with no commercial solver license, back-tested against the production system's own historical targets.

text.default: Build a live multi-site data layer over read-only Seeq historian pulls, with per-site mapping driven by configuration rather than forks and automated operating-window qualification excluding downtime.
text.deep: Build a live multi-site data layer over read-only Seeq (SPy) historian pulls, mapping each site through configuration rather than forks (status predicates, production thresholds, time zones, tag mapping, unit overrides), with automated operating-window qualification excluding downtime, then Kalman smoothing, Welch PSD, lag and coherence, change-point detection (ruptures), and matrix-profile motifs (STUMPY) in SciPy and pandas.

text.default: Design a tool loop where a model emits schema-constrained JSON and the solver computes every number, gated by an automated numeric-fidelity check and a per-call audit log with no write path to plant control.
Build MCP servers, 20+ regression tests, a headless notebook runner, and a deterministic model stand-in for GPU-free CI, with golden snapshots committed for reproducible runs.

Harden global deployment with lock-pinned CUDA and CPU builds, OS trust-store integration for enterprise TLS-inspecting proxies, and an auditable decision register for every deviation from the vendor reference.

Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT solver for hybrid flow-shop scheduling, then compared 3 approaches (heuristic, MIP, and genetic algorithm) to turn production objectives and constraints into decision-ready schedules.
text.deep: Developed a SimPy discrete-event digital twin and OR-Tools CP-SAT solver for hybrid flow-shop scheduling over interval and precedence constraints, then compared 3 approaches (heuristic, MIP, and genetic algorithm) against heuristic baselines and researched robust optimization for operational uncertainty.

text.default: Validated a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline against 5 years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures across operator- and machine-generated anomalies.
text.deep: Validated a non-destructive, 15-stage changeover-data pipeline over operational matrices that encoded meaning in values, labels, colours, merged regions, and blanks, using controlled staging sheets, repair passes, From-To edge-list conversion, correction tables, audit outputs, and explicit exception handling to expose every intermediate state instead of mutating source data, against 5 years of unseen raw data with zero execution failures.

text.default: Productionized a team-built APC simulator for live internal users on Azure App Service with Docker packaging, access restrictions, and runtime and session hardening.
text.solution-architect: Owned cloud deployment and production support for a team-built APC simulator used in manufacturing and engineer training, with Docker packaging, Azure App Service hosting, and documented handover.
text.deep: Productionized a team-built Advanced Process Control simulator for live internal users on Azure App Service, handling Flask and JavaScript debugging, Docker packaging, session and request tracking, access restrictions, and documented deployment handover, with the originating team retaining authorship.

text.default: Trained regional engineering teams across Asia and Europe on repeatable AI workflows spanning 7 areas: prompting, model selection, benchmarks, cost awareness, agents, validation, and safeguards.

Strengthened Excel, VBA, Python, master-data, and scheduling workflows with 3 safeguards: validation rules, correction tables, and reproducible intermediate stages, leaving every transformation auditable.
Documented deployment, access provisioning, and technical handover across 3 procedures, so internal manufacturing and engineer-training users stayed supported after transfer to owning teams.
Delivered a digital garden-plot balloting platform across admin and public frontends, backend, GIS mapping, and deployment, now production-ready for national rollout across Singapore.
text.deep: Delivered an end-to-end digital garden-plot balloting platform across admin and public frontends, backend, GIS-based plot allocation, and deployment, coordinating stakeholders and rollout planning across product, engineering, and operations, now production-ready for national rollout across Singapore.

text.default: Integrated Singpass Login (OIDC) to secure resident sign-in and Myinfo to verify identity and address, keeping garden-plot balloting fair for 150 residents signed up at release.
text.deep: Integrated Singpass Login (OIDC) to secure resident sign-in and Myinfo to retrieve verified identity and registered address under resident consent, automating eligibility checks so garden-plot balloting stayed fair for 150 residents signed up at release.

fairness-first.text: Integrated Singpass Login (OIDC) to secure resident sign-in and Myinfo to verify identity and address for fair garden-plot balloting across 150 residents signed up at release.
fairness-first.note: closes on the fairness outcome as a noun phrase rather than a trailing participle

text.default: Won a S$20,000 Sparks Community Innovation Fund award for public good initiatives, then led deployment planning, multi-repo coordination, and stakeholder management across product, engineering, and operations.
Provisioned AWS infrastructure with Terraform across 8 services: ECS Fargate, Multi-AZ RDS Postgres with PostGIS, ALB fronted by WAFv2, Route 53, ACM, KMS, and Secrets Manager.
text.deep: Owned cloud deployment for the balloting platform: Terraform-provisioned AWS infrastructure across 8 services (ECS Fargate, Multi-AZ RDS Postgres with PostGIS, ALB fronted by WAFv2, Route 53, ACM, KMS, and Secrets Manager), with cloud security controls applied environment-wide alongside multi-repo coordination and rollout planning.

text.default: Engineered keyless GitHub Actions CI/CD on IAM OIDC federation across 5 pinned service repos, with gated Fargate migrations, mandatory RDS snapshots, and circuit-breaker auto-rollback.
Conducted field surveys of garden sites and structured physical plot records into geospatial datasets driving 3 platform workflows: mapping, plot allocation, and site planning.

Designed rules-based balloting workflows across 4 control points: eligibility checks, conflict resolution, exception handling, and administrative oversight, keeping allocation transparent and auditable.
